meeting.title: Flock Freight status call
meeting.summary: Short, noncommittal status call with Flock Freight. Derek acknowledged the open items are stalled on his side but would not commit to dates — internal quarter-end reporting is consuming the team. Maya offered help; Derek deferred everything to 'after quarter-end' without specifics. No new work agreed.
meeting.notes: Derek joined 5 minutes late and dropped early for another call. Engagement noticeably lower than in May.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Hi Derek — thanks for squeezing this in, I know things are hectic. I wanted to check where the open items stand on your side.

transcript.speaker: Derek Liang
transcript.text: Yeah, sorry for being slow lately. Honestly, nothing has moved. Quarter-end reporting has eaten the whole team.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Understood. Is there a point in the next couple of weeks where the warehouse permissions work could realistically restart?

transcript.speaker: Derek Liang
transcript.text: Hard to say. Maybe after quarter-end? I'd need to check with our platform person and she's buried too.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Okay. Would it help if we took more of it — for instance we could draft the permission grants so it's a review rather than a build?

transcript.speaker: Derek Liang
transcript.text: Possibly. Let me think about it — I don't want to promise review time I don't have either.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: That's fair. And the pilot-group question from May — any movement on who'd be in it?

transcript.speaker: Derek Liang
transcript.text: Not yet. We should probably revisit that once reporting season is over. I just can't put a date on it right now.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Alright. I don't want to pile pressure on a crunch — I'd rather find the realistic restart point than invent deadlines we'll miss.

transcript.speaker: Derek Liang
transcript.text: Appreciate that. Truthfully, mid-July is my best guess for when we can breathe again, but don't hold me to it.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Noted as a guess, not a promise. I'll keep our side warm so nothing rots in the meantime.

transcript.speaker: Derek Liang
transcript.text: Thanks Maya. Sorry — I have to drop for another call. Talk soon.

toolCalls.dueDateReason: Derek: 'mid-July is my best guess' → Wed 15 Jul.
toolCalls.sourceQuoteContains: mid-July is my best guess for when we can breathe again

expected.notes: Champion overwhelmed by quarter-end: Derek commits to nothing, and nothing should go on his plate (no new customer tasks, no re-dating his open tasks t1/t2). But Maya needs plenty from him, so the right output is a reminder on Maya's side to circle back with Derek mid-July (15 Jul) about the pilot group and restarting the warehouse permissions work (or reviewing grants Maya drafts).
